videoDetails.title: LIVE: Anders Hejlsberg on TypeScript’s Go Port
videoDetails.shortDescription:
I'll be chatting to Anders Hejlsberg, TypeScript's co-creator and lead architect, about their upcoming Go rewrite. They've achieved 10x speedups on large repositories, and up to 15x speedups in some repo's.

Get ready to ask the TypeScript Gandalf your questions!

Full details: https://www.totaltypescript.com/typescript-announces-go-rewrite
Why Go: https://github.com/microsoft/typescript-go/discussions/411
